title: A newly provisioned dev connector never runs its first ingest in time

problem.observed_on_vm: Deploy run 35842520262 (ref fdd259ce9, merge of PR #5958) failed at 'Ensure governed dev paper baseline under lease' with: timed out waiting for admissible market snapshot for symbol SPY: market_input_stale (snapshot event_time 2026-09-13T03:59:39Z is stale 884524.6s > 86400s). connector_count moved from 2 to 3 for the first time (PR #5958's ordering fix worked, the dev-paper-us-equity-simulation connector was registered), persona-b52db9473b6e0396f4d9 reached provisioning step schedule_registered, but source_ingest.data_source_instances stayed 0, pantheon-source-ingest-1 never logged an execution attempt for the connector, and connector_schedule.jsonl showed the schedule entry go enabled=true at 09:40:43Z then enabled=false at 09:41:37Z when the failed baseline run's saga compensated.
problem.root_cause: scripts/bootstrap_dev_paper_baseline.py's ensure_dev_market_snapshot_ready only actively nudged a fresh ingest pass (POST /api/source-ingest/run-scheduled) when the polled snapshot was entirely missing (HTTP 404). When the polled snapshot already existed but was stale (HTTP 200 with an old event_time -- exactly the 2026-09-13 snapshot the VM observed, left over from an earlier partial provisioning attempt on that host), the wait loop only re-polled the same read-only GET endpoint and never triggered a new pull. A stale snapshot can never become fresh on its own, so the bounded wait could only ever time out with market_input_stale regardless of how long the timeout budget was. This is a distinct bug from DEV-PAPER-SNAPSHOT-PRECONDITION-ORDERING-001 (which fixed the connector/schedule *registration* ordering, confirmed working here by connector_count 2->3 and provisioning_step=schedule_registered): that task made the connector exist in time; this task's gap was that once it existed, a pre-existing stale snapshot on the host still blocked its first real pull from ever being triggered.
problem.why_the_scheduler_container_never_ran_it: source-ingest-scheduler (pantheon-source-ingest-scheduler-1) runs controller_worker.py, whose SOURCE_INGEST_CONTROLLER_MODE defaults to reconcile_only (docker-compose.yml). reconcile_only mode is deliberately the always-safe half of the source loop: it reconciles Persona.required_data_sources into configured connectors and enabled schedules (explaining the connector_schedule.jsonl entry), but by design never calls run-scheduled or otherwise executes a provider pull (services/source_ingestion/controller_worker.py: reconcile_only mode must not select provider connector execution). Triggering the first real pull for a freshly provisioned connector is therefore the bootstrap script's own responsibility via its bounded ensure_dev_market_snapshot_ready wait, not the scheduler container's -- which is why pantheon-source-ingest-1 (the API/worker process the scheduler's reconcile-only tick and the bootstrap's own nudge both ultimately call into) never logged an execution attempt: nothing had ever asked it to run one for this connector.

owned: scripts/bootstrap_dev_paper_baseline.py: ensure_dev_market_snapshot_ready now nudges POST /api/source-ingest/run-scheduled whenever the polled snapshot is not yet admissible for any reason (missing, stale, future-dated, or insufficient closes), not only on HTTP 404. Extracted the nudge into a small _nudge_run_scheduled helper reused by every non-fresh branch. The nudge remains best-effort (a failed nudge never aborts the caller's own bounded wait) and carries the resolved source-ingest controller bearer token exactly as before.

scripts/bootstrap_dev_paper_baseline.py AC2 fix (this revision, addressing the independent reviewer's rejection): _nudge_run_scheduled no longer discards the nudge's HTTP status/body/exception in a bare `except Exception: pass` -- it now returns a bounded diagnostic dict (http_status, body, failed[], transport_error). A new _nudge_diagnostic_summary helper turns that into a connector-identity-plus-reason string (an HTTP 401/403 authorization denial, a per-connector `failed: [{connector_id, error}]` entry from run-scheduled's own response, or a transport exception) and, when present, ensure_dev_market_snapshot_ready overrides last_reason/last_detail to `ingest_nudge_failed` carrying that string, so the bounded timeout error names the connector and the real HTTP/provider/transport reason instead of only the polling-side market_input_stale/market_snapshot_not_found label. A clean HTTP 200 nudge with no per-connector failures still yields no diagnostic override, leaving the pre-existing market-snapshot-derived reason as the surfaced timeout cause (unchanged steady-state/no-op behavior). ensure_paper_baseline now also threads each required data source's connector_candidates through to this diagnostic so it can identify which failed-list entries are relevant to the connector actually being waited on.

scripts/test_bootstrap_dev_paper_baseline.py: updated test_replay_with_stale_snapshot_still_raises_market_input_stale to assert the nudge now fires on the one stale observation before the bounded deadline is hit; added test_market_snapshot_wait_nudges_stale_existing_snapshot_then_succeeds (a stale existing snapshot on a host converges to ok once the nudge lands a fresh one, proving AC1/AC5 for the exact failure mode observed on the VM); added a run-scheduled response to _replay_post_queue so the shared replay-path fixture supports the nudge; added (this revision) test_market_snapshot_wait_surfaces_nudge_authorization_denial (independently reproduces the reviewer's HTTP 403 finding and asserts the connector/reason surface in the timeout error), test_market_snapshot_wait_surfaces_nudge_connector_provider_failure (independently reproduces the reviewer's HTTP 200 failed=[{connector_id, error}] finding), and two direct unit tests of _nudge_diagnostic_summary's no-diagnostic and transport-error paths.

scripts/bootstrap_dev_paper_baseline.py (run_self_tests): Test 4 (insufficient closes) and Test 5 (stale snapshot) now patch _post_json and assert a nudge call happened; Test 6 (future-dated snapshot) now patches _post_json to avoid an unmocked network call now that its branch also nudges.
not_changing: services/source_ingestion/persona_source_reconciler.py and services/source_ingestion/runtime.py: read for this investigation (they own connector/schedule registration and reconcile-only-mode provider-execution boundary), but the observed failure was not in their code path -- connector registration and schedule creation already worked correctly per the VM evidence (connector_count 2->3, schedule entry written). No change needed; services/source_ingestion/tests/test_controller_worker.py stays green unmodified (see verification).

services/source_ingestion/controller_worker.py: SOURCE_INGEST_CONTROLLER_MODE=reconcile_only staying the scheduler's default is intentional (services/source_ingestion/controller_worker.py's own comments and config_from_env validation say a provider-executing tick requires explicitly selected exclusive_connector_ids); the fix keeps the scheduler container's safe-by-default posture unchanged and instead fixes the one caller (the bootstrap script) that is already responsible for triggering a bounded first pull.

the daily schedule cadence itself (interval_seconds=86400, JsonlConnectorScheduleStore): unchanged. The nudge calls the existing run_scheduled_connectors endpoint, which already skips any connector whose watermark is inside its cadence interval (services/source_ingestion/pipeline.py) -- a repeated nudge during steady state is a no-op for an already-fresh connector, so AC3 (cadence unchanged after the first run) holds without any change to the scheduling code. Independently reconfirmed in this revision's zero-instance hosted reproduction: the idempotent replay bootstrap invocation produced zero additional ingest_run_id entries (see verification.hosted_reproduction_ac5).
composes_with: PR #5958 / DEV-PAPER-SNAPSHOT-PRECONDITION-ORDERING-001's connector/schedule registration ordering fix, which this delivery relies on being already merged (base_sha fdd259ce9 is that merge commit) and does not modify.

the source-ingest-scheduler container's reconcile_only tick, which keeps running unchanged in parallel and keeps connector/schedule config converged; this delivery only changes what the bootstrap script itself does while waiting.

the next real redeploy onto the affected dev VM: this delivery does not run nonprod-deploy or otherwise touch the shared dev VM (that shared CI/CD workflow is fleet infrastructure this task does not own per AI_COLLABORATION_GUIDE.md's Shared Deploy Workflow Ownership section), but it does independently reproduce the identical zero-instance code path the VM's own deploy step exercises via a fully isolated, disposable local docker-compose project (see verification.hosted_reproduction_ac5).
prior_delivery_correction: The prior delivery's evidence.json (superseded by this revision) claimed at deliberately_not_attempted that 'the task brief explicitly states Human/Ops owns the redeploy and this task must not run nonprod-deploy'. The independent reviewer correctly found this unsupported: the task brief (see .orchestrator/worker-runtime/task-context/dev-paper-first-ingest-on-provision-001.md, reproduced in this task's ai-status.json row) contains no such statement. The actual, narrower constraint is AI_COLLABORATION_GUIDE.md's Shared Deploy Workflow Ownership section: nonprod-deploy.yml is shared CI/CD infrastructure this task does not own and must not disable or cancel runs of -- it says nothing about a local, isolated, disposable docker-compose reproduction. This revision corrects the record by actually performing that reproduction (see verification.hosted_reproduction_ac5) rather than repeating the unsupported citation.

acceptance_mapping.acceptance: a connector provisioned for a brand new persona produces its first snapshot without waiting for its cadence interval
acceptance_mapping.evidence: Pre-existing coverage (test_market_snapshot_wait_runs_after_persona_creation_never_provisioned_first_run) already proved this for the never-provisioned (HTTP 404) case. This delivery adds the second real-world shape observed on the VM: a host with a pre-existing *stale* snapshot, via the new test_market_snapshot_wait_nudges_stale_existing_snapshot_then_succeeds.

acceptance_mapping.acceptance: that first run is bounded and observable and its failure names the connector and the reason
acceptance_mapping.evidence: ensure_dev_market_snapshot_ready still raises BootstrapError naming the symbol and the exact last_reason/last_detail (market_snapshot_not_found / market_input_stale / market_input_invalid / market_input_insufficient) within the caller-supplied bounded timeout. This revision additionally fixes the independent reviewer's AC2 rejection: _nudge_run_scheduled no longer discards the run-scheduled nudge's own HTTP status/body/exception -- an HTTP 401/403 authorization denial, a per-connector `failed: [{connector_id, error}]` entry, or a transport exception now overrides last_reason to `ingest_nudge_failed` carrying the connector identity and the real HTTP/provider/transport reason, verified by test_market_snapshot_wait_surfaces_nudge_authorization_denial and test_market_snapshot_wait_surfaces_nudge_connector_provider_failure, which independently reproduce the reviewer's exact HTTP 403 and HTTP 200 failed=[...] findings.

acceptance_mapping.acceptance: the configured daily cadence is unchanged for every run after the first
acceptance_mapping.evidence: The nudge only calls the existing /api/source-ingest/run-scheduled endpoint, whose run_scheduled_connectors (services/source_ingestion/pipeline.py) already skips a connector whose watermark is inside its interval_seconds; no schedule-store code was touched.

acceptance_mapping.acceptance: no snapshot is fabricated or backdated and the freshness rule stays intact
acceptance_mapping.evidence: The fix only ever triggers the real scheduled ingest pipeline (run_scheduled_connectors -> the connector's own provider fetch); it does not write, seed, or backdate any snapshot record itself. The freshness comparison in ensure_dev_market_snapshot_ready (event_time age <= 86400s, not in the future) is unchanged.

acceptance_mapping.acceptance: a deploy onto a host with zero data source instances completes the governed paper baseline end to end
acceptance_mapping.evidence: Independently re-proven end-to-end in this revision by a real, isolated, disposable local docker-compose reproduction (project dpsp-ac5) -- see verification.hosted_reproduction_ac5. A fresh host with independently-confirmed-via-psql zero data_source_instances/source_observed_snapshots/personas completed the governed dev-paper baseline end to end through a single unmodified bootstrap.py process invocation reaching authoritative state=paper_running/provisioning_state=succeeded with exit 0, followed by a same-idempotency-key replay proving a persisted receipt, and independent psql/HTTP verification of the persona row, the newly-provisioned connector, and a snapshot produced live inside the run's own wall-clock window. This directly supersedes the prior delivery's deferred/unsupported deliberately_not_attempted claim (see scope.prior_delivery_correction).

acceptance_mapping.acceptance: regression tests cover the first run after provisioning and the steady state cadence
acceptance_mapping.evidence: scripts/test_bootstrap_dev_paper_baseline.py: test_market_snapshot_wait_runs_after_persona_creation_never_provisioned_first_run (never-provisioned first run), test_market_snapshot_wait_nudges_stale_existing_snapshot_then_succeeds (stale-on-record first run), test_market_snapshot_already_fresh_steady_state_does_not_delay_reconcile and test_replay_with_fresh_snapshot_returns_ok_after_one_get (steady state, no nudge); this revision adds test_market_snapshot_wait_surfaces_nudge_authorization_denial and test_market_snapshot_wait_surfaces_nudge_connector_provider_failure (AC2 diagnostic-surfacing regressions) plus two direct unit tests of _nudge_diagnostic_summary. Corroborated end-to-end by the zero-instance hosted reproduction's own first-invocation-vs-replay pair (verification.hosted_reproduction_ac5), which independently confirmed zero additional ingest_run_id entries and an unchanged interval_seconds=86400 schedule record across the replay.
